title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 0-RTT Replay Protection Work Item
summary: Add DNS opcode replayability classification, client 0-RTT gating, and server 0-RTT transaction queue with limit.
planned_changes:
- Add DoqDefaults.IsReplayableOpcode static method classifying OPCODE 0 (QUERY) and 4 (NOTIFY) as replayable.
- Add DoqClient.AllowZeroRtt property; catch non-replayable opcodes in QueryAsync when AllowZeroRtt is true.
- Add DoqQueryContext.IsZeroRtt property for server-side 0-RTT signal (default false, transport placeholder).
- Add DoqServerOptions.MaxQueuedZeroRttTransactions for server-side queue limit.
- Add server 0-RTT handling pathway that queues non-replayable 0-RTT queries and responds REFUSED+EDE Too Early.
- Add focused unit and integration tests.
verification_plan: Run DoQ foundation tests, stream lifecycle tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene.
completion_notes: All 8 REQs are now traced and verified. Opcode classification, client gating, and server queue handling are implemented.
